en.content: The decreasing order of reactivity of the following compounds towards nucleophilic substitution (SN2) is :

options.content: (IV) > (II) > (III) > (I)
(II) > (III) > (IV) > (I)
(II) > (III) > (I) > (IV)

en.explanation: –NO2 group present at ortho and para position deactivate the benzene ring and making the carbon attached to ring (–CH2Cl) group more electrophilic for the incoming nucleophile to give SN2 reaction but rate of SN2 reaction decreases as hindrence increases around the electrophilic carbon.
